Kuvitus: kaksi kattolamppua rinnakkain i: Illustration: two ceiling lamps side by side above a table in a room in the evening. On the left an incandescent bulb whose filament glows and around which heat shimmers; on the right an LED bulb. Both cones of light on the table are equally bright.
Energiavirtakuvio mittakaavassa: hehkula: Energy flow diagram to scale: an incandescent lamp takes electrical energy of 100 J. Electricity flows from the left into the picture of the lamp. To the right continue a thin green arrow, the light energy of 5 J, and a thick orange arrow, the heat energy of 95 J. The thicknesses of the arrows are proportional to the energies, so the share of light is 5 percent of the incoming energy.
Kaksi energiavirtakuviota samassa mittak: Two energy flow diagrams on the same scale. At the top, an incandescent lamp takes a power of 60 W and gives a light power of 3 W; the efficiency is 5 percent, and 57 W becomes heat. At the bottom, an LED lamp takes a power of 10 W and gives the same light power of 3 W; the efficiency is 30 percent, and 7 W becomes heat. In both, the green arrow of light power is equally thick, but the incoming arrow of the LED lamp is one sixth of the incoming arrow of the incandescent lamp.
Energiavirtakuvio mittakaavassa ruutupap: Energy flow diagram to scale on squared paper: electrical energy of 240 J enters an electric motor. The thickness of the incoming arrow is 8 squares. A green arrow of useful energy, kinetic energy, leaves the motor to the right and is 2 squares thick, and an orange arrow of losses, heat, curves downward and is 6 squares thick. The thicknesses of the arrows are proportional to the energies; the values of the useful energy and the losses are not marked.
